motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That Aird & Berlis LLP be appointed as the City of Guelph’s Closed Meeting Investigator. That the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized to execute an agreement to contract the services of Aird & Berlis LLP as the City of Guelph’s Closed Meeting Investigator. That By-law Number (2026) – 21249, included as Attachment-1 to report 2026-250, dated June 2, 2026, be brought forward for approval.
motions.text_html:
1. That Aird & Berlis LLP be appointed as the City of Guelph’s Closed Meeting Investigator.
  2. That the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized to execute an agreement to contract the services of Aird & Berlis LLP as the City of Guelph’s Closed Meeting Investigator.
  3. That By-law Number (2026) – 21249, included as Attachment-1 to report 2026-250, dated June 2, 2026, be brought forward for approval.

motions.item_title: Recommendation Report - New Fee Structure for Building Permit Applications - 2026-251
motions.text: That the Recommendation Report - New Fee Structure for Building Permit Applications be received. That the amendment to Schedule “A” of the Building By-law (2015) – 19985, as shown in Attachment-2, be approved. That the amendment to Tables 5 and 79 of the User Fees By-law (2025) - 21164, as shown in Attachment-3, be approved. That Council approve adjusting the Building Services OBC Stabilization Reserve Fund target to be within the range of 100 to 300 per cent of prior year budget operating expenditures and direct staff to update the General Reserve and Reserve Fund Policy. That Council approve the recommended automatic fee indexing methodology for 2028 and subsequent years, as described in the Recommendation Report - New Fee Structure for Building Permit Applications. That Council direct staff to consider the advantages and disadvantages of implementing the proposed new administrative fees as set out in Section 5 of the BMA report and bring any further recommendations to Council for approval as part of the 2027 budget confirmation.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Recommendation Report - New Fee Structure for Building Permit Applications be received.
  2. That the amendment to Schedule “A” of the Building By-law (2015) – 19985, as shown in Attachment-2, be approved.
  3. That the amendment to Tables 5 and 79 of the User Fees By-law (2025) - 21164, as shown in Attachment-3, be approved.
  4. That Council approve adjusting the Building Services OBC Stabilization Reserve Fund target to be within the range of 100 to 300 per cent of prior year budget operating expenditures and direct staff to update the General Reserve and Reserve Fund Policy.
  5. That Council approve the recommended automatic fee indexing methodology for 2028 and subsequent years, as described in the Recommendation Report - New Fee Structure for Building Permit Applications.
  6. That Council direct staff to consider the advantages and disadvantages of implementing the proposed new administrative fees as set out in Section 5 of the BMA report and bring any further recommendations to Council for approval as part of the 2027 budget confirmation.

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned (8:00 p.m.).
